sentences.text: DATED:- 15-09-2023  Shri M.L.Tomar - Advocate for the appellant.
Smt. Anjali Gyanani - Public Prosecutor for the respond No.1/State.

Per Justice Deepak Kumar Agarwal:
Heard on I.A. No.14295/2023, first application under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant-Jitendra Meena.

This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 28.04.2023 passed in Special Case No.112/2021 by learned Special Judge (POCSO Act) Shivpuri (M.P.), whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
Section Sentence Fine (Rs.) Default Stipulation 363 of IPC 2 Years R.I. 1000/- 6 Months RI 366 of IPC 3 Years R.I. 1000/- 6 Months RI 6 of Protection of 20 Years R.I. 1000/- 1 year RI Children from Sexual Offences Act 2012

In brief, case of the prosecution is that, on 28.05.2021, father of the prosecutrix lodged an F.I.R. with Police Station Rannod District Shivpuri alleging that on 21.05.2021,
complainant-father of the prosecutrix along with the other family members went to sleep after taking dinner in the house.
The prosecutrix was sleeping alone in a room.
In the morning, when grandmother of prosecutrix entered into the room, she found the prosecutrix missing.
Some unknown person by enticing her took her away.
They searched the prosecutrix but she could not be traced.

On the basis of complaint of the complainant, F.I.R. bearing crime No.80/2021 was lodged against unknown person for the offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC at Police Station Rannod District Shivpuri.

sentences.text: During investigation, the prosecutrix was recovered on 01.06.2021.
Her statements were recorded.
As per her statements, the appellant by enticing her took her away with the aid of co-accused Haricharan Pal and committed sexual intercourse with her.
On the basis of her statements, appellant and co-accused Haricharan Pal
were arrested.

After investigation, charge sheet was filed against the present appellant and co-accused Haricharan Pal for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from sexual offences Act, 2012 before the competent court from where case was committed to Special Court for its trial.

entities.text: Protection of Children from sexual offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appellant abjured his guilt and pleaded complete innocence.
After conclusion of trial, the trial Court convicted and sentenced present appellant vide impugned judgment for the offence as mentioned above.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has been wrongly convicted by the learned trial Court.
It is further submitted that the learned trial Court committed a grave error in convicting the appellant solely relying upon the statements of interested witnesses.
It is further submitted that due to previous enmity, the appellant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Appellant has suffered about seven months of incarceration and he is the permanent resident of District- Vidisha (M.P.) and there are fair chances of success of this appeal.
Present appeal is of the year 2023 and final hearing of the case will take time.
Under these circumstances, the execution of jail sentence be suspended and the appellant be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposed the bail application and prayed for rejection of this application.
Keeping in view of the aforesaid submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting upon merits of the case, IA No. 14295/2023 is allowed.

It is, therefore, directed that if appellant deposits the entire fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 20th December,
2023 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed in this regard, sentence of imprisonment awarded to him, shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.
I.A. No. 14295/2023 stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
